calculation.description: Ranks tradable benchmark instruments by lagged 20-session momentum, modestly amplified when short-term average volume exceeds its 60-session average. The one-session shift prevents look-ahead and tanh bounds the volume confirmation.

validation.regime_notes: Validated on the 15-instrument cross-asset universe with at least 8 valid instruments per date. Full sample and recent 260-session results clear the benchmark absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840 gates. Coverage is reduced by asynchronous volume availability; valid-date cross-sections remain adequate but uncertainty should be interpreted conservatively.
